'''Darsie Vundt''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Rampa III]] native and grew up in a middle-class family but despised the life she was born into. She lashed out at society by [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] into local information networks. She got caught by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], but was offered a position in the [[Operational Multisystem Management]] department. She chose to be free, and became one of the Authority's most prominent OMM programmers.
